title: Booz Allen to Host Conference Call to Discuss Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results on Friday, October 23, 2026
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Booz Allen Hamilton's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://investors.boozallen.com/node/20791/pdf)


MCLEAN, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 11, 2026-- Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corporation (NYSE: BAH), the parent company of advanced technology company Booz Allen Hamilton Inc., will host a conference call at 8 a.m. EDT on Friday, October 23, 2026, to discuss the financial results for the Second Quarter of Fiscal 2027 (ending September 30, 2026). A press release containing the results will be issued before the call.


Participants may register for the earnings webcast at[investors.boozallen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.boozallen.com%2F&esheet=54602093&newsitemid=20260911338930&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.boozallen.com&index=1&md5=71c38cc42444397b6b1a91a97f01d2c2) . A replay of the webcast will also be available on the site beginning at 11 a.m. EDT on Friday, October 23, 2026, and continuing for 12 months.


**About Booz Allen Hamilton**


Booz Allen is an advanced technology company. We build commercial-grade products and solutions for America’s most critical defense, civil, and national security priorities. For more information, visit[www.boozallen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.boozallen.com&esheet=54602093&newsitemid=20260911338930&lan=en-US&anchor=www.boozallen.com&index=2&md5=ddbafa48966d20595b34494296260134) .
